messages:
Ravi Kapoor: Quick experiment proposal 00: compare inline estimator vs modal trigger on pricing page. Primary goals: increase "estimate" clicks and demo requests for high-value leads.

Maya Chen: Love it. Keep it lightweight: 2-week run, equal traffic split, and AE route for predicted annual >= 48k.

Elena Park: For copy variants, test CTAs: "Estimate my monthly cost" vs "Get tailored pricing". Also test tier labels: Developer/Team/Enterprise.

Omar Haddad: Sales note: AE capacity limited Tues/Thu mornings. Add fallback to SDR queue. We'll need webhook test.

sales-ops-bot: Staging webhook: https://hooks.internal.redwood/pricing-test. Use X-RW-Env: staging. Rule id: rr_pricing_2026_test.

Ravi Kapoor: Telemetry events: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_cta_click, pricing_lead_routed. Tag with calc_variant and tier_name_variant.

Maya Chen: Timeline: wire events + webhook (1 day), copy + design QA (1 day), launch A/B (14 days), review. Meet in 7 days to check early signals.

Elena Park: I'll drop initial copy in the doc and upload two design frames to Figma. Link in thread when ready.

Omar Haddad: Confirming fallback logic and EU exclusion for AE routing until legal signs off.

Ravi Kapoor: Great. I'll create the GA experiment and post the ID here when live.

Maya Chen: Thanks team 1: small, measurable, and reversible. Let's keep the calc assumptions visible to reduce confusion.
